intro: Look To The Stars begins Viktori Prism'Antras's endeavor to gaze past the eerie canopy of Duskwood. Believing that a scientific answer beyond arcane superstition explains the forest's dark curse, Viktori recruits you to gather components for a telescope designed by his gnomish associate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.
Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer. That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is perfect, friend. The first step is complete!
